title_sq: Ne Astir, Tek Vila L2 Shitet Apartament 1+1 Totalisht I Investuar!!
description_sq: Ne Astir Tek Vila L2, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Totalisht I Investuar!! title_en: In Astir, at Vila L2, 1+1 Apartment for sale, Totally Invested!!
description_en: In Astir At Vila L2, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, Totally Invested!! The apartment with a gross area of ​​72.42 m2 and a net area of ​​61.70 m2 is located on the 7th residential floor of a well-managed building with an elevator and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette with access to the balcony, a bedroom and a toilet. The apartment is all invested and furnished with all the necessary things in a modern way. It is oriented towards the West. The area in which the apartment is located is very preferred for residence and investment as it offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, such as urban transport, supermarkets, bars, pharmacies, etc. The apartment is currently rented for 400 euros per month.
